note: THE PAVEMENTS H1 IS FALSIFIED ON HALF THE COMPASS, AND IT APPEARS NEVER TO HAVE BEEN RUN. Relevant to anyone touching movement, heading_rose, or walk-band navigation. The Pavement (decision block 0506-0511) preregistered H1: from 200 seed-42 start cells, walking n for 500 steps stays within 0.5 cell of the starting meridian -- the direct repair of The Rhumbs falsified unbounded drift of ~0.086 step-lengths per step. The Newel re-ran it over 216 start cells at walk depth 13, simulating the walk with the same call Session::go makes (heading_rose(here)[word]), cross-checked against a real 40-step Session::go walk to six decimal places. RESULT, equatorial faces, cross-track in step-lengths: N and S worst mean 0.00, 0 of 144 failing -- EXACT. E and W worst mean 69.85, 144 of 144 failing, 0.1445 step-lengths per step, and the same figure against the great circle as against the parallel. That is 1.68x the number The Pavement quotes as the defect it repairs, and about 78 km off course over 563 km walked. WHY N PASSES AND W DOES NOT: on a cube-sphere face the constant-a lines are planes containing the polar axis, so they cut the sphere in MERIDIANS, which are great circles. H1 chose the one direction where the meridian and the great circle are the same line, so it cannot fail. Had it been written on e it would have failed on the first start cell. AND IT LOOKS UNRUN: windows/vessel/examples/pavement_probe.rs, which the plan Step 1 names as a file to create, does not exist; grep -rln meridian over the rust tree returns no vessel or locale file; and neither the chronicle nor the retrospective reports an H1 result though both report H2 and H3. CONSEQUENCE FOR ANYONE READING section 3.4: course.rs was deleted on the argument that with eight real edges the mapping is the identity. That is true of ONE STEP and false of a WALK -- a greedy per-step nearest-bearing rule cannot correct accumulated cross-track error, because the correcting move is a diagonal 45 degrees off the word and always scores worse on the per-step metric. Correction needs the carried ideal line, which is what Course was. The Newel is holding at G3 on whether to take this.
